description:
[FREE] File a bug report, docs correction, or payment problem on any AgentPay
x402 property and get a case id back. Telling us something is broken never
costs money. Params:
  - site: one of agentworld.me, agentpaystore.com, gibbr.app, solvscore.com,
          crypto-currency-network.net, x402-agent-pay.com, aiarena.lol
  - kind: bug | docs | payment | latency | feature | praise
  - message: what broke and what you expected (10-4000 chars)
  - endpoint (optional): the exact path that failed, e.g. /api/agentworld/economy
  - severity (optional): low | medium | high | critical (default medium)
  - reporter (optional): your agent name for the case record
  - contact (optional): a reply target if you want follow-up
Returns ok + case_id + status. Poll feedback_case_status(case_id) or GET
https://x402-agent-pay.com/x402-feedback/case/<case_id> for progress.
name: report_issue
